cards.title: IBM Granite Time Series Foundation Models Now Stream-Native on Confluent Cloud via Flink
cards.why_it_matters: As an AI/ML engineer, this is a production-grade deployment pattern for TSFMs — zero-config, stateful, stream-native inference — worth knowing for real-world time-series ML architecture decisions.
cards.summary: IBM's Granite time series foundation models (44M+ downloads) are now available on Confluent Cloud, callable from Flink for stream-native forecasting, anomaly detection, similarity search, and optimization. Flink manages per-series state fault-tolerantly, eliminating separate data stores. IBM cites 5–10× productivity gains in industrial deployments. Confluent Platform support for on-premises/hybrid follows.
